cases.statement: One carrier, HA20-1 in 39167656 (female; unrelated, 'none' under Family), studied before and during infliximab treatment.

people.label: HA20-1
people.zygosity_or_genotype: not reported per person; cohort described as heterozygous (cohort-level)
people.key_phenotypes: constitutive NF-κB activation and raised proinflammatory cytokines (especially TNF) before treatment; reduced B cell repertoire richness and diversity; expansion of IGHV4-34+ B cells; treated with infliximab

quotes.quote: Upon initiation of therapeutic TNF antagonism, patient HA20-1 normalized her B cell repertoire metrics to richness and diversity measures characteristic of blood B cells of healthy individuals (Fig. 3C).
Before treatment initiation, this patient showed classical A20 deficiency with constitutive NF-κB activation (Fig. 3A) and excessive proinflammatory cytokine elevations, especially TNF (Fig. 3B).
To study this, we longitudinally assessed immune repertoires in patient HA20-1 on treatment with the TNF antagonist infliximab.
Moreover, before treatment initiation, this patient showed strong polyclonal expansion of IGHV4-34^+ B cells

phenotype_specificity.statement: Clinical features are not described; the paper reports laboratory and repertoire findings only. No statement on testing of other genes.

quotes.quote: Before treatment initiation, this patient showed classical A20 deficiency with constitutive NF-κB activation (Fig. 3A) and excessive proinflammatory cytokine elevations, especially TNF (Fig. 3B).

functional.statement: Patient cells (PBMCs): immunoblot of A20 and nuclear translocation of p65 against one healthy donor; the authors report 'classical A20 deficiency with constitutive NF-κB activation' before treatment, plus raised plasma cytokines compared with six healthy donors. The converted text gives no quantification of the A20 band.

quotes.quote: Before treatment initiation, this patient showed classical A20 deficiency with constitutive NF-κB activation (Fig. 3A) and excessive proinflammatory cytokine elevations, especially TNF (Fig. 3B).
(A) Immunoblotting of A20 and NF-κB status in PBMCs from patient HA20-1 and a healthy individual (HD). NF-κB activation was assessed by nuclear translocation of p65.
(B) Mean (±SD) cytokine plasma levels of patient HA20-1 at initial presentation (day 0) and at indicated follow-up time points as compared to six HDs.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-nucleotide duplication causing a frameshift, p.(Ala545SerfsTer127) (from the batch HGVS); the paper writes p.Ala545fs*127. The paper describes HA20 as caused by heterozygous germline loss-of-function variants.

quotes.quote: Haploinsufficiency of A20 (HA20) is a severe childhood-onset inflammatory disease characterized by heterozygous germline loss-of-function (LOF) mutations in TNFAIP3 (1, 2).

concerns: Nonstandard notation in 39167656: 'c.1631dupC' and 'p.Ala545fs*127' (no new amino acid); the batch protein_check reports agreement with p.(Ala545SerfsTer127).

The frameshift adds 127 codons before a stop, so the predicted product is a C-terminally altered protein of near full length; the paper does not discuss transcript or protein fate for this variant beyond the patient-cell immunoblot.
No case description (age, onset, clinical features); the variant appears in Table S1 and in the functional/repertoire results only.
No transcript stated; the batch uses NM_001270508.2.
notes_for_panel: The only person-specific functional evidence in this batch from 39167656: a patient-PBMC immunoblot (A20 and p65 nuclear translocation) in HA20-1.
